title: When is the flood update published

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: What time does the district post the flood news?

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: Are you calling because someone is in danger?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: No, no. Just the time of the update.

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: Which district are you asking about?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Long District, Phrae. I am at the invented tea stall.

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: Anyone with you who needs help today?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Just me. This is only a question.
